title: Mushroom Chicken Piccata
description: The classic chicken piccata recipe, featuring chicken cooked with white wine, lemon juice, and butter, gets a lovely boost with the addition of mushrooms.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, for garnish

steps.text: Mix egg and milk together in a shallow bowl. Mix flour, salt, and paprika together in a second shallow bowl. Dip chicken into egg mixture, then lift up so excess egg drips back into the bowl. Press into flour mixture to coat both sides.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and sauté until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Add mushrooms and onion; sauté for 3 to 5 minutes.

Mix broth, wine, lemon juice, and cornstarch together in a medium bowl; pour over chicken and mushrooms. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear, about 25 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

video.description: Mushrooms take classic chicken piccata to new heights of flavor.
